method: matching-terms phrase "best time to visit", where volume>=400 AND serp_domain_rating_top10_min<=35
why_this_is_the_strongest_family_found: Open SERPs at scale on a family whose DATA IS ALREADY ON DISK. Livdar holds NASA POWER monthly climate normals for 31,715 cities, which is exactly what a best-time page needs: temperature, rainfall and daylight by month, per entity, from a named source. The entity axis is destination, not city alone, so it extends to states, parks and islands.
